` with `` or CSS animation - Sun: circular gradient with glowing rays - Planets: circles with radial gradients - Day/night: overlay each planet with a moving dark semi-transparent ellipse or gradient mask - Gears: SVG paths/circles with teeth, rotating in opposite directions - Orbital speeds: give outer planets slower angular motion: - Mercury fastest - Venus slightly slower - Earth slower - Mars slower - a fictional outer “brass planet” slowest
Simple motion formula for orbit animation:
- angular speed proportional to 1 / orbital period² - Example ratios can be visually tuned: - Mercury: 0.25s-ish relative rotation period - Venus: 0.9s - Earth: 1.5s - Mars: 2.4s - Outer planet: 4s
Day/night effect:
- Give each planet a rotating dark half-plane - Use a gradient overlay like: - opaque dark on one side - transparent on the other - Animate the planet’s rotation independently from its orbit
